title: Two records whose identifiers differ only in case
intent: Identity is case-sensitive, so CO1 and co1 are two companies. Relationship endpoints must be matched the same way. Folding case here did both halves of the harm at once: a reference to co1 resolved to the record whose id is CO1, inventing an endpoint no source record has, and two companies differing only in case made every reference to either of them ambiguous, refusing relationships that are perfectly clear. Each contact points at its own company.
